an7.81:1.1: LXXVII. Sattahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato vinayadharo sobhati. Katamehi sattahi? Āpattiṃ jānāti, anāpattiṃ jānāti, lakukaṃ āpattiṃ jānāti, garukaṃ āpattiṃ jānāti, vinaye kho pana ṭhito hoti asaṃhiro, catunnaṃ jhānānaṃ . . . pe . . . akasiralābhī, āsavānaṃ khayā . . . pe . . . sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati. Imehi kho bhikkhave sattahi dhammehi samannāgato vinayadharo sobhatī ti.
